## Overview

This release adds opt-in, click-driven reveals shared by the Canvas Extension,
CLI and Desktop. Reveal list items with their nested items together or separately,
reveal Architecture elements and groups by stable IDs, or use
`<!-- markdstage: reveal=block -->` to reveal an entire paragraph, image, list,
table, code block, Architecture diagram or Mermaid diagram in source order.

Exported PowerPoint presentations retain editable objects and play the same
sequence as native Appear builds without duplicating slides. Desktop PowerPoint
playback was verified for all four sample themes and Mermaid Images mode,
including simultaneous targets, previous builds, and save/reopen.

Static viewing, editing, output preview, PDF and PNG continue to show complete
content. Presenter and audience windows share the current build, and all four
sample decks include progressive-reveal examples.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing decks without reveal directives
remain fully visible, and the CLI arguments and VS Code integration protocol are
unchanged. Reveal directives are opt-in and require this version or later.
Unsupported or overlapping reveal targets produce explicit validation errors.

PowerPoint slideshow playback was verified with Windows desktop PowerPoint
16.0.20430.20092. PowerPoint Web and LibreOffice playback remain unverified.
Previously exported files do not acquire the repaired timing automatically:
restart an already-running MarkdStage instance and export a new PPTX.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.6.0`. |
| Existing Markdown decks | No changes required; add reveal directives only when progressive presentation is desired. |
| Existing PowerPoint exports | Re-export with this version to obtain working click-driven builds. |
| Mermaid reveals | Reveal the complete diagram as one block in both Editable shapes and Images modes. |
